name: Aeroplan
notes: Premier program for Air Canada. 1:1 transfer from Amex MR, CIBC Aventura, TD Rewards (via AC)

name: Scene+
best_redemption: Travel via Scene+ Travel portal / Cineplex / groceries at Sobeys/IGA/FreshCo
notes: Fixed value 1cpp. Shell joined Scene+ March 2026. Scotiabank primary issuer.

name: BMO Rewards
best_redemption: Travel via BMO Rewards portal (150 pts = $1)
notes: Transitioning to Blue Rewards Summer 2026. AIR MILES → Blue Rewards conversion ~16 Blue Pts per AIR MILE June 1, 2026.

name: BMO Blue Points
notes: Replacing BMO Rewards + AIR MILES Summer 2026. Blue Rewards WE: 10pts/$1 partners (6.70% yield). Coming Summer 2026.

name: TD Rewards
notes: 200 pts = $1 via Expedia for TD. ~0.5cpp. Per-category spend caps apply on most cards.

name: RBC Avion Elite
best_redemption: Avios or AAdvantage transfer / Air Travel Redemption Chart
notes: Elite tier = access to BA Avios 1:1, Asia Miles 1:1, AAdvantage 1:0.7. Premium tier (ION/ION+) only gets WestJet 1:1.

name: WestJet Rewards
notes: Fixed 1cpp. Dollar-denominated WestJet dollars. Best for WestJet frequent flyers.

name: PC Optimum
best_redemption: Loblaws / Shoppers Drug Mart / Esso checkout
notes: 10,000 pts = $10. Best value at Shoppers/Loblaws. Earns 25pts/$1 base, 45pts at Shoppers with PC World Elite.

name: Canadian Tire Money
best_redemption: Canadian Tire family stores (CT, Sport Chek, Mark's, Party City)
notes: 1:1 cash equivalent at Canadian Tire stores. Fixed value.

name: AIR MILES
notes: Legacy program transitioning to BMO Blue Rewards Summer 2026. AIR MILES Cash/Dream split eliminated Jan 25, 2026. BMO primary issuer. Sunsetting.

name: CIBC Aventura
notes: Aventura redemption: Airline Travel Reward Chart (fixed, best value on premium routes) OR flexible 1cpp. No caps on most Aventura cards.

name: Amex Membership Rewards Canada
notes: Transfer ratios (Canada): Aeroplan 1:1, BA Avios 1:0.75, Marriott 1:1.2, Hilton 1:1.5, Flying Blue 1:1 (improved Jan 3, 2026 from 1:0.75), Asia Miles 1:0.75. Etihad Guest ends Jun 30, 2026. MR Select (Business Edge) cannot transfer to airlines.

name: Marriott Bonvoy
notes: Transfers 3:1 to ~40 airlines. Annual Free Night Award up to 35K pts on Amex Marriott cards.

name: British Airways Avios
notes: RBC British Airways VI earns Avios directly. Best value on short-haul oneworld routes.

name: Cathay Asia Miles
notes: Transfer from Amex MR 1:0.75, RBC Avion Elite 1:1.

name: Neo Cashback
notes: 1% guaranteed + variable 5-15% at 10,000+ Neo partners. Variable rate depends on partner.

name: Brim Points
notes: 1pt = 1¢ at base. Up to 3¢+ at Brim partners. Flexible redemption.

name: NBC À la carte
notes: National Bank proprietary points. Best value via NBC Travel agency.

name: MBNA Rewards
notes: TD-owned brand. 1cpp fixed via travel portal.

name: Rogers Cashback
notes: 1:1 cash. No expiry. Rogers/Fido customers get enhanced earn on Rogers purchases.

name: Desjardins BONUSDOLLARS
notes: $1 = $1 BONUSDOLLAR. Fixed value. Flexible redemption including RRSP contribution.

name: United MileagePlus
notes: Primarily earned via MBNA. Star Alliance.

name: PC Financial Rewards
notes: Same PC Optimum program. PC Financial credit cards earn PC Optimum points. World Elite earns 45pts/$1 at Shoppers.

name: Triangle Rewards
notes: Canadian Tire Money earned as CT Money. Best value in CT ecosystem.
